title: Enabled-scout cap must be resolved via team_limits and before any transaction/row lock
answers: How is the max enabled scouts per project determined?
Where do I change the enabled scout limit for a project?
Why can't I read the signals-scout flag inside transaction.atomic in scout config writes?
body:
The enabled-scout ceiling is NOT the constant `MAX_ENABLED_SCOUTS_PER_TEAM` (limits.py) at enforcement points; it is resolved via `scout_harness/team_limits.py`: `resolve_max_enabled_scouts(layers)` (layers already held) or `max_enabled_scouts_for_team(canonical_team_id)` (one flag read). Order: `team_configs[project]` -> `default_team_config` -> constant, key `max_enabled_scouts` in the `signals-scout` payload.
Invalid values (None, 0, negative, float, str, bool) fall through to the next layer; a flag read failure yields the constant, never 0.
Enforcement points that must all use it: `views._reject_if_enabled_cap_reached(..., cap=)`, `views.create_scout_for_source`, config `create`/`partial_update`, `config_registry.register_missing_configs`, and `SignalScoutConfig.transition_status_by_system` in models.py.
Resolve the cap BEFORE `transaction.atomic()` (flag read = network); locked callers pass the resolved value down (`max_enabled_scouts=` kwarg on `transition_status_by_system`, `reconcile_operational_configs`, `_resume_operational_config`).
Metadata `limits.max_enabled_scouts` (ScoutLimitsSerializer) must report the same resolver's value.
applies: products/signals scout_harness config write paths, auto-registration, system resume, metadata endpoint
